harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Converted western.txt and utf8.txt into normalized/ as strict UTF-8 with LF endings. Accented characters, one empty record, and each file’s final-newline state were preserved. invalid.txt contains invalid UTF-8 byte 0xff at offset 15; it was reported and no partial output was published. All sources remain unchanged. Node1 restarted successfully and recovered with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Created normalized/ with root:root ownership and mode 0755.
Published western.txt and utf8.txt atomically with mode 0644.
Rejected invalid.txt without character replacement or destination output.
Verified exact normalized bytes, strict UTF-8, LF-only endings, empty records, and EOF-newline states.
Confirmed source SHA-256 checksums before and after conversion and restart.
Safely restarted node1 and verified full recovery without changing RHEL 10.0 or kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

evidence.summary: invalid.txt remained absent from normalized/, with no temporary output residue.
